claims.claim: Registers the interactive /btw command with status, cancellation, fresh, and fork handling.
Exposes exactly read, grep, find, and ls to child sessions and instructs them not to mutate project state.
Disables ambient extensions, skills, prompt templates, and themes before creating the child with the read-only tool list.
Fork mode captures the persisted parent branch before preparing the private child session.
Limits execution to three active jobs, ten queued jobs, and a five-minute per-job timeout.
Runs a child prompt asynchronously and finalizes the job with its answer.
Appends terminal results to the parent transcript and maintains a generic active-work widget.
Cancels managed work and clears the widget when the parent session shuts down.
